speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
ज्ञानं कर्म च कर्ता च त्रिधैव गुणभेदतः ।
प्रोच्यते गुणसंख्याने यथावच्छृणु तान्यपि ॥
iast:
jñānaṃ karma ca kartā ca tridhaiva guṇabhedataḥ |
procyate guṇasaṃkhyāne yathāvacchṛṇu tānyapi ||
english: Knowledge, action and the doer are said, in the account of the gunas, to be of three kinds each, according to the gunas. Hear about these as they are.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सर्वभूतेषु येनैकं भावमव्ययमीक्षते ।
अविभक्तं विभक्तेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि सात्त्विकम् ॥
iast:
sarvabhūteṣu yenaikaṃ bhāvamavyayamīkṣate |
avibhaktaṃ vibhakteṣu tajjñānaṃ viddhi sāttvikam ||
english: The knowledge by which one sees in all beings one imperishable reality, undivided among the divided, know that knowledge to be sattvic.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
पृथक्त्वेन तु यज्ज्ञानं नानाभावान्पृथग्विधान् ।
वेत्ति सर्वेषु भूतेषु तज्ज्ञानं विद्धि राजसम् ॥
iast:
pṛthaktvena tu yajjñānaṃ nānābhāvānpṛthagvidhān |
vetti sarveṣu bhūteṣu tajjñānaṃ viddhi rājasam ||
english: But the knowledge that sees in all beings many separate realities, of different kinds, each apart from the others, know that knowledge to be rajasic.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यत्तु कृत्स्नवदेकस्मिन्कार्ये सक्तमहैतुकम् ।
अतत्त्वार्थवदल्पं च तत्तामसमुदाहृतम् ॥
iast:
yattu kṛtsnavadekasminkārye saktamahaitukam |
atattvārthavadalpaṃ ca tattāmasamudāhṛtam ||
english: But the knowledge that clings to one single thing as if it were the whole, without reason, missing the truth and narrow, is called tamasic.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
नियतं सङ्गरहितमरागद्वेषतः कृतम् ।
अफलप्रेप्सुना कर्म यत्तत्सात्त्विकमुच्यते ॥
iast:
niyataṃ saṅgarahitamarāgadveṣataḥ kṛtam |
aphalaprepsunā karma yattatsāttvikamucyate ||
english: Action that is prescribed, done without attachment, without attraction or aversion, by one who does not crave its fruit, is called sattvic.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यत्तु कामेप्सुना कर्म साहंकारेण वा पुनः ।
क्रियते बहुलायासं तद्राजसमुदाहृतम् ॥
iast:
yattu kāmepsunā karma sāhaṃkāreṇa vā punaḥ |
kriyate bahulāyāsaṃ tadrājasamudāhṛtam ||
english: But action done by one who craves desires, or with ego, with great strain, is called rajasic.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अनुबन्धं क्षयं हिंसामनवेक्ष्य च पौरुषम् ।
मोहादारभ्यते कर्म यत्तत्तामसमुच्यते ॥
iast:
anubandhaṃ kṣayaṃ hiṃsāmanavekṣya ca pauruṣam |
mohādārabhyate karma yattattāmasamucyate ||
english: Action undertaken out of delusion, without regard to consequences, loss, harm to others, or one's own capacity, is called tamasic.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
मुक्तसङ्गोऽनहंवादी धृत्युत्साहसमन्वितः ।
सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योर्निर्विकारः कर्ता सात्त्विक उच्यते ॥
iast:
muktasaṅgo'nahaṃvādī dhṛtyutsāhasamanvitaḥ |
siddhyasiddhyornirvikāraḥ kartā sāttvika ucyate ||
english: A doer who is free of attachment, does not talk of 'I', is full of steadiness and enthusiasm, and is unchanged by success and failure, is called sattvic.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
रागी कर्मफलप्रेप्सुर्लुब्धो हिंसात्मकोऽशुचिः ।
हर्षशोकान्वितः कर्ता राजसः परिकीर्तितः ॥
iast:
rāgī karmaphalaprepsurlubdho hiṃsātmako'śuciḥ |
harṣaśokānvitaḥ kartā rājasaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||
english: A doer who is passionate, craves the fruits of action, is greedy, harmful and impure, and is swept by joy and grief, is called rajasic.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अयुक्तः प्राकृतः स्तब्धः शठो नैष्कृतिकोऽलसः ।
विषादी दीर्घसूत्री च कर्ता तामस उच्यते ॥
iast:
ayuktaḥ prākṛtaḥ stabdhaḥ śaṭho naiṣkṛtiko'lasaḥ |
viṣādī dīrghasūtrī ca kartā tāmasa ucyate ||
english: A doer who is undisciplined, coarse, stubborn, deceitful, malicious, lazy, despondent and procrastinating is called tamasic.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
बुद्धेर्भेदं धृतेश्चैव गुणतस्त्रिविधं शृणु ।
प्रोच्यमानमशेषेण पृथक्त्वेन धनंजय ॥
iast:
buddherbhedaṃ dhṛteścaiva guṇatastrividhaṃ śṛṇu |
procyamānamaśeṣeṇa pṛthaktvena dhanaṃjaya ||
english: Now hear, Arjuna, the threefold division of understanding and of fortitude according to the gunas, explained fully and separately.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च कार्याकार्ये भयाभये ।
बन्धं मोक्षं च या वेत्ति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी ॥
iast:
pravṛttiṃ ca nivṛttiṃ ca kāryākārye bhayābhaye |
bandhaṃ mokṣaṃ ca yā vetti buddhiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī ||
english: The understanding that knows when to act and when to refrain, what should and should not be done, what is to be feared and what is not, and what binds and what frees, son of Pritha, is sattvic.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यया धर्ममधर्मं च कार्यं चाकार्यमेव च ।
अयथावत्प्रजानाति बुद्धिः सा पार्थ राजसी ॥
iast:
yayā dharmamadharmaṃ ca kāryaṃ cākāryameva ca |
ayathāvatprajānāti buddhiḥ sā pārtha rājasī ||
english: The understanding by which one knows wrongly what is dharma and what is not, what should and should not be done, son of Pritha, is rajasic.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अधर्मं धर्ममिति या मन्यते तमसावृता ।
सर्वार्थान्विपरीतांश्च बुद्धिः सा पार्थ तामसी ॥
iast:
adharmaṃ dharmamiti yā manyate tamasāvṛtā |
sarvārthānviparītāṃśca buddhiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī ||
english: The understanding which, covered by darkness, takes adharma for dharma and sees all things in reverse, son of Pritha, is tamasic.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
धृत्या यया धारयते मनःप्राणेन्द्रियक्रियाः ।
योगेनाव्यभिचारिण्या धृतिः सा पार्थ सात्त्विकी ॥
iast:
dhṛtyā yayā dhārayate manaḥprāṇendriyakriyāḥ |
yogenāvyabhicāriṇyā dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha sāttvikī ||
english: The unwavering fortitude by which, through yoga, one controls the activities of mind, breath and senses, son of Pritha, is sattvic.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यया तु धर्मकामार्थान्धृत्या धारयतेऽर्जुन ।
प्रसङ्गेन फलाकाङ्क्षी धृतिः सा पार्थ राजसी ॥
iast:
yayā tu dharmakāmārthāndhṛtyā dhārayate'rjuna |
prasaṅgena phalākāṅkṣī dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha rājasī ||
english: But the fortitude by which one holds to dharma, pleasure and wealth, Arjuna, craving their fruits out of attachment, son of Pritha, is rajasic.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यया स्वप्नं भयं शोकं विषादं मदमेव च ।
न विमुञ्चति दुर्मेधा धृतिः सा पार्थ तामसी ॥
iast:
yayā svapnaṃ bhayaṃ śokaṃ viṣādaṃ madameva ca |
na vimuñcati durmedhā dhṛtiḥ sā pārtha tāmasī ||
english: The fortitude by which a foolish person does not let go of sleep, fear, grief, despondency and arrogance, son of Pritha, is tamasic.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सुखं त्विदानीं त्रिविधं शृणु मे भरतर्षभ ।
अभ्यासाद्रमते यत्र दुःखान्तं च निगच्छति ॥
iast:
sukhaṃ tvidānīṃ trividhaṃ śṛṇu me bharatarṣabha |
abhyāsādramate yatra duḥkhāntaṃ ca nigacchati ||
english: Now hear from me, best of the Bharatas, about the three kinds of happiness: the happiness one comes to enjoy through practice, in which sorrow comes to an end,

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यत्तदग्रे विषमिव परिणामेऽमृतोपमम् ।
तत्सुखं सात्त्विकं प्रोक्तमात्मबुद्धिप्रसादजम् ॥
iast:
yattadagre viṣamiva pariṇāme'mṛtopamam |
tatsukhaṃ sāttvikaṃ proktamātmabuddhiprasādajam ||
english: That which is like poison at first but like nectar in the end, born of the clarity of one's own understanding, is called sattvic happiness.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
विषयेन्द्रियसंयोगाद्यत्तदग्रेऽमृतोपमम् ।
परिणामे विषमिव तत्सुखं राजसं स्मृतम् ॥
iast:
viṣayendriyasaṃyogādyattadagre'mṛtopamam |
pariṇāme viṣamiva tatsukhaṃ rājasaṃ smṛtam ||
english: That which arises from the contact of the senses with their objects, like nectar at first but like poison in the end, is held to be rajasic happiness.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यदग्रे चानुबन्धे च सुखं मोहनमात्मनः ।
निद्रालस्यप्रमादोत्थं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम् ॥
iast:
yadagre cānubandhe ca sukhaṃ mohanamātmanaḥ |
nidrālasyapramādotthaṃ tattāmasamudāhṛtam ||
english: The happiness that deludes the self both at first and in the end, arising from sleep, laziness and carelessness, is called tamasic.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
न तदस्ति पृथिव्यां वा दिवि देवेषु वा पुनः ।
सत्त्वं प्रकृतिजैर्मुक्तं यदेभिः स्यात्त्रिभिर्गुणैः ॥
iast:
na tadasti pṛthivyāṃ vā divi deveṣu vā punaḥ |
sattvaṃ prakṛtijairmuktaṃ yadebhiḥ syāttribhirguṇaiḥ ||
english: There is no being on earth, or in heaven among the gods, that is free of these three gunas born of nature.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
ब्राह्मणक्षत्रियविशां शूद्राणां च परन्तप ।
कर्माणि प्रविभक्तानि स्वभावप्रभवैर्गुणैः ॥
iast:
brāhmaṇakṣatriyaviśāṃ śūdrāṇāṃ ca parantapa |
karmāṇi pravibhaktāni svabhāvaprabhavairguṇaiḥ ||
english: The duties of brahmins, kshatriyas and vaishyas, and of shudras too, Arjuna, are divided according to the gunas that arise from their own nature.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
शमो दमस्तपः शौचं क्षान्तिरार्जवमेव च ।
ज्ञानं विज्ञानमास्तिक्यं ब्रह्मकर्म स्वभावजम् ॥
iast:
śamo damastapaḥ śaucaṃ kṣāntirārjavameva ca |
jñānaṃ vijñānamāstikyaṃ brahmakarma svabhāvajam ||
english: Calm, self-restraint, austerity, purity, patience, honesty, knowledge, insight and faith are the work of a brahmin, born of their nature.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
शौर्यं तेजो धृतिर्दाक्ष्यं युद्धे चाप्यपलायनम् ।
दानमीश्वरभावश्च क्षात्रं कर्म स्वभावजम् ॥
iast:
śauryaṃ tejo dhṛtirdākṣyaṃ yuddhe cāpyapalāyanam |
dānamīśvarabhāvaśca kṣātraṃ karma svabhāvajam ||
english: Courage, vigour, steadiness, skill, not fleeing in battle, generosity and leadership are the work of a kshatriya, born of their nature.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
कृषिगौरक्ष्यवाणिज्यं वैश्यकर्म स्वभावजम् ।
परिचर्यात्मकं कर्म शूद्रस्यापि स्वभावजम् ॥
iast:
kṛṣigaurakṣyavāṇijyaṃ vaiśyakarma svabhāvajam |
paricaryātmakaṃ karma śūdrasyāpi svabhāvajam ||
english: Farming, tending cattle and trade are the work of a vaishya, born of their nature; and work that consists of service is the shudra's, also born of their nature.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
स्वे स्वे कर्मण्यभिरतः संसिद्धिं लभते नरः ।
स्वकर्मनिरतः सिद्धिं यथा विन्दति तच्छृणु ॥
iast:
sve sve karmaṇyabhirataḥ saṃsiddhiṃ labhate naraḥ |
svakarmanirataḥ siddhiṃ yathā vindati tacchṛṇu ||
english: Each devoted to their own work, a person attains perfection. Hear how one devoted to their own work finds perfection.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
यतः प्रवृत्तिर्भूतानां येन सर्वमिदं ततम् ।
स्वकर्मणा तमभ्यर्च्य सिद्धिं विन्दति मानवः ॥
iast:
yataḥ pravṛttirbhūtānāṃ yena sarvamidaṃ tatam |
svakarmaṇā tamabhyarcya siddhiṃ vindati mānavaḥ ||
english: By worshipping, through their own work, the one from whom all beings arise and by whom all this is pervaded, a person attains perfection.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
श्रेयान्स्वधर्मो विगुणः परधर्मात्स्वनुष्ठितात् ।
स्वभावनियतं कर्म कुर्वन्नाप्नोति किल्बिषम् ॥
iast:
śreyānsvadharmo viguṇaḥ paradharmātsvanuṣṭhitāt |
svabhāvaniyataṃ karma kurvannāpnoti kilbiṣam ||
english: Better one's own dharma, though imperfect, than another's dharma well performed. Doing the work set by one's own nature, one incurs no fault.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सहजं कर्म कौन्तेय सदोषमपि न त्यजेत् ।
सर्वारम्भा हि दोषेण धूमेनाग्निरिवावृताः ॥
iast:
sahajaṃ karma kaunteya sadoṣamapi na tyajet |
sarvārambhā hi doṣeṇa dhūmenāgnirivāvṛtāḥ ||
english: Do not give up the work you were born to, son of Kunti, even if it has faults; for all undertakings are clouded by fault, as fire is by smoke.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
असक्तबुद्धिः सर्वत्र जितात्मा विगतस्पृहः ।
नैष्कर्म्यसिद्धिं परमां संन्यासेनाधिगच्छति ॥
iast:
asaktabuddhiḥ sarvatra jitātmā vigataspṛhaḥ |
naiṣkarmyasiddhiṃ paramāṃ saṃnyāsenādhigacchati ||
english: One whose understanding is unattached everywhere, who has mastered themselves and is free of craving, reaches through renunciation the supreme perfection of freedom from action.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सिद्धिं प्राप्तो यथा ब्रह्म तथाप्नोति निबोध मे ।
समासेनैव कौन्तेय निष्ठा ज्ञानस्य या परा ॥
iast:
siddhiṃ prāpto yathā brahma tathāpnoti nibodha me |
samāsenaiva kaunteya niṣṭhā jñānasya yā parā ||
english: Learn from me briefly, son of Kunti, how one who has reached perfection attains Brahman, which is the highest culmination of knowledge.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
बुद्ध्या विशुद्ध्या युक्तो धृत्यात्मानं नियम्य च ।
शब्दादीन्विषयांस्त्यक्त्वा रागद्वेषौ व्युदस्य च ॥
iast:
buddhyā viśuddhyā yukto dhṛtyātmānaṃ niyamya ca |
śabdādīnviṣayāṃstyaktvā rāgadveṣau vyudasya ca ||
english: Endowed with a purified understanding, controlling oneself with steadiness, turning away from sound and the other objects of the senses, and casting aside attraction and aversion,

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
विविक्तसेवी लघ्वाशी यतवाक्कायमानसः ।
ध्यानयोगपरो नित्यं वैराग्यं समुपाश्रितः ॥
iast:
viviktasevī laghvāśī yatavākkāyamānasaḥ |
dhyānayogaparo nityaṃ vairāgyaṃ samupāśritaḥ ||
english: living in solitude, eating lightly, with speech, body and mind controlled, always intent on the yoga of meditation, taking refuge in dispassion,

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
अहंकारं बलं दर्पं कामं क्रोधं परिग्रहम् ।
विमुच्य निर्ममः शान्तो ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते ॥
iast:
ahaṃkāraṃ balaṃ darpaṃ kāmaṃ krodhaṃ parigraham |
vimucya nirmamaḥ śānto brahmabhūyāya kalpate ||
english: letting go of ego, force, arrogance, desire, anger and possessions, free of the sense of 'mine' and at peace, one becomes fit to attain the state of Brahman.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
ब्रह्मभूतः प्रसन्नात्मा न शोचति न काङ्क्षति ।
समः सर्वेषु भूतेषु मद्भक्तिं लभते पराम् ॥
iast:
brahmabhūtaḥ prasannātmā na śocati na kāṅkṣati |
samaḥ sarveṣu bhūteṣu madbhaktiṃ labhate parām ||
english: Having attained the state of Brahman, serene within, one neither grieves nor craves; equal towards all beings, one gains supreme devotion to me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
भक्त्या मामभिजानाति यावान्यश्चास्मि तत्त्वतः ।
ततो मां तत्त्वतो ज्ञात्वा विशते तदनन्तरम् ॥
iast:
bhaktyā māmabhijānāti yāvānyaścāsmi tattvataḥ |
tato māṃ tattvato jñātvā viśate tadanantaram ||
english: Through devotion one comes to know me truly, how great I am and who I am; then, having known me truly, one enters into me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
सर्वकर्माण्यपि सदा कुर्वाणो मद्व्यपाश्रयः ।
मत्प्रसादादवाप्नोति शाश्वतं पदमव्ययम् ॥
iast:
sarvakarmāṇyapi sadā kurvāṇo madvyapāśrayaḥ |
matprasādādavāpnoti śāśvataṃ padamavyayam ||
english: Even while always doing all kinds of action, one who takes refuge in me reaches, by my grace, the eternal, imperishable state.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
चेतसा सर्वकर्माणि मयि संन्यस्य मत्परः ।
बुद्धियोगमुपाश्रित्य मच्चित्तः सततं भव ॥
iast:
cetasā sarvakarmāṇi mayi saṃnyasya matparaḥ |
buddhiyogamupāśritya maccittaḥ satataṃ bhava ||
english: Mentally offering all actions to me, holding me as the highest, relying on the yoga of understanding, keep your mind always on me.

speaker: Krishna
devanagari:
मच्चित्तः सर्वदुर्गाणि मत्प्रसादात्तरिष्यसि ।
अथ चेत्त्वमहंकारान्न श्रोष्यसि विनङ्क्ष्यसि ॥
iast:
maccittaḥ sarvadurgāṇi matprasādāttariṣyasi |
atha cettvamahaṃkārānna śroṣyasi vinaṅkṣyasi ||
english: With your mind on me, you will cross every difficulty by my grace; but if out of ego you will not listen, you will be lost.
